exposure: inpatient reported quality of recovery (ObsQoR-10 at discharge)
outcome: outpatient global recovery (ObsQoR-10, Global Health Scale (GHVAS) on postpartum day seven)
depression screening scores (Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale)
cohort: The study included women in labor who underwent vaginal, operative vaginal, or intrapartum cesarean birth.
finding: ObsQoR-10 scores at discharge demonstrated an association with postpartum recovery and depression screening scores, suggesting that the ObsQoR-10 could identify women at increased risk of postpartum anxiety or depression.
